message: 「The magic circle is complete. Now, all that's left is to wait for the appointed time...」
「Still, the preparations went far too easily. I had a bad feeling about it, though--was it just my imagination...?」
「But with this, I too can finally be with the angel--」
「This stirring, this mana... Of everyone I know, the only ones capable of undoing this magic circle are--」
「The Nive Clan--so they really did exist!!」
